title: Croatian-Style Vegan Skewers
description: A delicious and healthy vegan skewer recipe inspired by the flavors of Croatia. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, onion, and a pinch of salt.
Add the sliced mushrooms and bell peppers to the bowl, tossing to coat.
Thread the marinated vegetables onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill.
